These hypotheses come from the 100 experiments plus general knowledge of the benchmark. The experiments are all single-parent results, so each is weak evidence on its own.

- **Strongest pattern:** adding a conv to an all-skip or all-avg_pool parent gains +30 to +45 points on CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100, and +7 to +17 on ImageNet16-120. This is because such parents have no parametric operation anywhere. The conv upgrade hypotheses below rest on this.
- **Weakest hypotheses:**
  - Edge 3 → none, with edge 3 = avg_pool_3x3 (rests on one big result, plus a small positive).
  - Edge 0 → skip_connect, with edge 1 = skip_connect (one huge drop and one moderate drop).
  - Edge 3 → skip_connect, with edge 3 = none (mixed on CIFAR-100).
  - Edge 4 → skip_connect, with edge 4 = nor_conv_3x3 (one huge drop, one mixed result).
